heading_en: General Market Risk of the Interest Rate Risk Category
summary_ja: 金利リスク・カテゴリーの一般市場リスクの額を、マチュリティ法またはデュレーション法により通貨ごとに算出した全体のネット・ポジションと各ディスアローアンスの合計とし、期間帯の表を示す。
summary_en: Defines the general market risk of the interest rate risk category as the overall net position plus vertical and horizontal disallowances, calculated by currency under the maturity or duration method, and gives the time-band tables.
paragraphs: The amount of general market risk of the interest rate risk category set forth in Article 271, paragraph (1), item (i) shall be the total of the following, calculated for each currency using the maturity method prescribed in the following Article or the duration method prescribed in Article 272-7; provided, however, that an Ultimate Designated Parent Company using the duration method shall prepare and retain documents describing matters concerning the method of measuring price sensitivity and shall continue to use that measurement method: (i) the amount of the overall net position in debt instruments, etc.; (ii) the amount of vertical disallowance (meaning the portion, obtained by multiplying the offsetting portion by a certain ratio when offsetting opposite positions within the same time band, that is added to the market risk equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter) between offsetting positions within each time band set forth in the table in (a) below where the maturity method is used, or in the table in (b) below where the duration method is used: (a) Time bands, etc. under the maturity method {{T:p405t1}} (Note) A zero-coupon bond shall be treated as a bond with a coupon of less than 3%. (b) Time bands, etc. under the duration method {{T:p406t1}}; (iii) the amount of horizontal disallowance (meaning the portion, obtained by multiplying the offsetting portion by a certain ratio when offsetting opposite positions between time bands, that is added to the market risk equivalent amount; the same applies hereinafter) between offsetting positions across the time bands set forth in the following table {{T:p406t2}} (Note) Where the amount of horizontal disallowance is calculated under the duration method, the column for coupons of less than 3% shall be used for the time bands.
